items.name: Tenshi-Do Martial Arts
items.area_served: Ravenhall, near Caroline Springs (Unit 5/94 Eucumbene Drive)
items.price: $444 for 20–40 guests (2 hours); $44 deposit; extra time $50 per half hour
items.description: Two-hour solo-hire ninja birthday parties at the dojo on Saturdays at 12.30pm: agility course, ninja star games, water pistol fights, sumo wrestling and the Gymbus, a double-decker bus fitted with gymnastics equipment, parked on site.

items.name: Chipmunks Playland & Cafe Caroline Springs
items.area_served: Caroline Springs
items.description: Kids' birthday parties with 1 hour in the playground then 1 hour with food in a private party room, themed partyware, invitations, party helper and unlimited play; themes include Race Car, Superhero, Princess, Unicorn, Jungle, Under the Sea and Pirate.

items.name: Funtastic Play Centre Caroline Springs
items.area_served: Caroline Springs (Level 4/173 Caroline Springs Blvd)
items.description: Indoor play centre parties with themed decorations, food, a private party room, a dedicated party host, entry and unlimited play; private venue hire also offered. Toddler zone for under 3s is listed for general play. General admission from $10.95 per child (checked 22 Oct 2026).

items.name: Zebraland
items.area_served: Melton (1/88 High Street)
items.price: Bronze package for 8 kids (base price not shown on packages page, 22 Oct 2026); extra kids $24.50
items.description: Eat, play and party centre with Bronze, Silver and Gold birthday packages: 2 hours of private party room time, kids' entry valid for the whole day, unlimited cordial and water and party food; choice of 3 party rooms.

items.name: Lollipop's Playland & Cafe Sunshine
items.area_served: Sunshine North (15/484-486 Ballarat Road)
items.description: Indoor birthday parties in themed Jungle, Princess, Kawaii or Superhero rooms with Classic, Lollipops, Premium or Ultimate packages, party invitations, hats, a dedicated host and party food; private after-hours hire also listed.

items.name: Crocs Playcentre Hoppers Crossing
items.area_served: Hoppers Crossing
items.description: Kids' birthday parties with themed party rooms, a dedicated party host and unlimited play, plus Build Your Own, Baking and Disco party options and private hire of the whole centre.

items.name: BouncyRoos at Werribee Indoor Sports
items.area_served: Werribee (13 Riverside Avenue)
items.description: Inflatable birthday parties with 2 hours of inflatable play and 90 minutes at a party table; catered and bring-your-own-food packages, plus a private venue take-over option.

items.name: The Amazing Mr Twist
items.area_served: Services all of Victoria, including Melbourne's west
items.description: Children's party magician offering comedy magic shows with live doves and puppets for kids' birthdays, schools and community events; balloon twisting and face painting also listed as extra services.

items.name: Balloonaversal Entertainments
items.area_served: Services all of Melbourne, especially northern and western suburbs (including Caroline Springs, Taylors Hill, Hillside, Melton, Deer Park, Sunshine and Werribee, as listed)
items.description: Super Pro Balloon Twisting for kids' parties, with balloon creations made on the spot; 1-hour booking listed for fewer than 10 children, longer bookings for larger groups. Magic shows and face painting also listed.

items.name: The Party Girl World - Sunshine
items.area_served: Servicing Sunshine, Sunshine West, Sunshine North, Albion, Melton South, Brookfield, Eynesbury and Exford (as listed)
items.description: Kids' parties with face painting and balloon sculpting, plus party styling and pamper parties through its Sunshine team.

items.name: Ready Steady Jump
items.area_served: Caroline Springs and Sunshine (dedicated hire pages for both suburbs)
items.description: Themed enclosed jumping castle hire for birthday parties and events, most with a built-in slide and basketball hoop, delivered and set up before the party and collected afterwards; popcorn, slushie and fairy floss machines also listed.

items.name: Child's Play Bounce N Jump Party Hire
items.area_served: City of Melton, including Caroline Springs, Taylors Hill, Hillside, Melton, Aintree, Fraser Rise and Deanside (as listed)
items.description: Jumping castle and bounce castle hire with delivery and setup across the City of Melton, themed and traditional castles, listed as fully insured and cleaned and sanitised before every hire.

items.name: Joyous Bouncy Castles
items.area_served: Melton and Sunshine (dedicated hire pages; serves Melbourne's western and northern suburbs)
items.ages: Up to 12 (small castles); up to 16 (medium castles, as listed)
items.description: Jumping castle hire in small, medium and large sizes with themes including Frozen, Avengers, Disney Princess, Peppa Pig and Spiderman for birthdays, school events and family gatherings.

items.name: Dreamscape - Face Painting & Balloon Twisting
items.area_served: Melbourne's western suburbs, including Sunshine, Deer Park, Caroline Springs, Taylors Lakes, Hillside and Keilor (as listed)
items.description: Face painting and balloon twisting for kids' birthday parties, with hypoallergenic paints, insured artists with Working With Children Checks, and designs from butterflies and superheroes to glitter tattoos.

items.name: Paint + Pop
items.area_served: Brimbank and Melton council areas, including Sunshine, Deer Park, Caroline Springs, Taylors Hill and Taylors Lakes (as listed)
items.description: Mobile face painting for children's parties and events, plus a pop-up photobooth and glitter bar; service-area page lists the Brimbank and Melton suburbs it covers.

items.name: L.A Party and Events Hire
items.area_served: Based in Hillside; services Caroline Springs, Taylors Hill, Deer Park, Melton, Truganina, Hoppers Crossing and Werribee (as listed)
items.description: Mobile wood-fired pizza catering for birthday parties, cooked fresh on site, with set pizza counts or unlimited packages and optional grazing platters, sweets and event hire.

items.name: Mamalyn Catering
items.area_served: Based in St Albans (67 Manfred Ave); services St Albans, Sunshine, Deer Park, Caroline Springs, Taylors Lakes, Keilor, Werribee and Melton (as listed)
items.description: Birthday party catering with buffet trays, finger food, platters and party boxes, including a kids' birthday catering section for simple, easy-to-hold food for children and enough savoury food for parents.

items.name: Landing Playcentre Ravenhall
items.area_served: Ravenhall (12 Nexus Street, near Caroline Springs)
items.description: Indoor playground parties in a private Fairy, Jungle or Space room for 2 hours with a party host, unlimited play, invitations and party food; Deluxe Spa Pamper Party also offered. $4 per adult entry with drink voucher.

items.name: FLIP Gymnastics Truganina
items.area_served: Truganina (34 Apex Dr)
items.description: Two-hour coach-led gymnastics party with skills session, trampoline activities, games, food time and free play; preschoolers need an adult on the floor.

items.name: Melton Waves
items.area_served: Melton (206 Coburns Road)
items.description: Two-hour pool parties at the council leisure centre: first hour of pool activities (Toddler party in the wave pool), second hour of food at a reserved table then free time in the leisure pool. Includes hot chips, cordial and water, lolly bags and two food items. Min 10 kids (Toddler max 15, other package max 30); subject to staff availability, book at least 2 weeks ahead.

items.name: Xplosions Bar & Bowl
items.area_served: Melton (1/25 Bakery Square)
items.ages: Grenade package for 8 and under; other packages not age-limited (as listed)
items.price: $29 per child (Grenade); $35 per child (Kids Karaoke or Xplosives)
items.description: Tenpin bowling and karaoke birthday parties with party food, a dedicated party host, a party area (about 45 minutes, often shared) and 10 arcade tokens. Grenade (5 frames, for 8 and under), Kids Karaoke (1 hour) and Xplosives (1 game). Parties run about 1.5-2 hours; minimum 8 children and $120 to book.
